beats.text: Next, two hundred reports, about twenty-three thousand tokens. That **fits**.
Pasting all of them in answered the counting question **three** out of three. Every tool setup got **zero**.
My first run said the opposite. I had capped the answer at twelve hundred tokens, and the model was **cut** off mid-count.
So first ask whether it **fits**. The checklist is the plan for when it **stops** fitting.
